content: SigNoz MCP server (github.com/SigNoz/signoz-mcp-server) is a Go binary, not a Python library. Install via binary download, go install, docker pull signoz/signoz-mcp-server, or make build. Runs as stdio (spawn as subprocess, recommended for local/self-hosted) or HTTP mode (TRANSPORT_MODE=http, MCP_SERVER_PORT). Config via env vars SIGNOZ_URL and SIGNOZ_API_KEY (from SigNoz Settings->API Keys). 40+ tools exposed: signoz_query_metrics, signoz_search_traces, signoz_search_logs, signoz_list_alerts, signoz_execute_builder_query, signoz_get_field_keys/values, etc. A Python client (using official mcp SDK) connects via stdio_client(StdioServerParameters(command=..., env={SIGNOZ_URL,SIGNOZ_API_KEY})) + ClientSession, calling session.list_tools() and session.call_tool().
